note: The `*_initialized_prefix_len` fields are semantic views over the concrete vulnerable-version scalar consumed at each event, measured with `__msan_test_shadow` over the 4-byte region that the later `unsigned int` / `uint32_t` read actually uses. `mcinst_init_slot1.slot1_imm_low32_bits` is the low 32-bit view of the same `inst->Operands[1].ImmVal` bytes that later flow into `Value`.
